---
description: tool_search as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
doing: looking for a tool
arguments:
  words: What to look for - what the tool does, its name, or its family.
  limit: The most tools to give.
---
Finds the tools you can call through tool_use beyond your own, by words in their names, families and descriptions. Each tool found comes with its name, its family, a line on what it does, and the arguments it takes.
